article.headline: Kimani Hamilton scores 26 to propel High Point past Presbyterian 77-66
article.description: — Kimani Hamilton scored 26 points as High Point beat Presbyterian 77-66 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Kimani Hamilton scores 26 to propel High Point past Presbyterian 77-66
article.story: HIGH POINT, N.C. -- — Kimani Hamilton scored 26 points as High Point beat Presbyterian 77-66 on Saturday night. Hamilton also had five rebounds for the Panthers (16-5, 4-2 Big South Conference). Bobby Pettiford shot 5 of 5 from the field to add 10 points. Chase Johnston hit all three of his shots and scored eight. Kory Mincy led the way for the Blue Hose (8-12, 1-4) with 18 points and four assists. Kobe Stewart added 14 points and four assists. Iverson King finished with 13 points, three steals and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
